scopes.notes: There is no test suite here at all and no CI workflow, so nothing runs on a pull request. A change is proven by `pnpm typecheck` plus a description of what a person should click; do not report a change as verified on the strength of a lint pass. ESLint is also the formatter — the antfu config carries the stylistic rules, and lint-staged runs `eslint --fix`, so there is no separate Prettier or oxfmt step. `pnpm typecheck` is `nuxt typecheck` and needs `.nuxt` to exist, which `postinstall` generates via `nuxt prepare`: on a fresh clone run `pnpm install` first or it fails on missing generated types rather than on your change. Components are shadcn-vue, generated into app/components/ui by the shadcn CLI against components.json — treat them as generated, add wrappers beside them rather than editing them in place. shadcn-nuxt is configured with an empty prefix, so they are auto-imported globally and need no import; the explicit `@/components/ui/...` form in existing code is for the non-component exports beside them. app/components/spark-ui is a second, hand-written set and is not generated. This repository is a fork of miantiao-me/Sink, so a change that could be made the way upstream would make it is cheaper to carry forward.
